svg.aria-label: Six consecutive daily agent runs: the run that failed outright was noticed the same morning, while the four runs after the OAuth token was added all exited 0 and wrote their artifact with the email and calendar connectors missing, and went unnoticed for four days.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The loud failure cost one run. The quiet one cost four.
